listing.name: Fleet Logistics
listing.summary: Adds a new ship that reduces fleet fuel and supply consumption, with adjustable reduction settings.

description:
A small mod for big fleets.

This mod introduces a new ship, called Fleet Overseer, which reduces the fuel and supply consumption of the player's fleet.

link

SpoilerFleet Observer:

[close]

Features

:

A new shipConfig file to change the consumption reduction, located at data/config/settings.json (default reduction is 30%)

(A new industry skill (needed for the mod to work))

As this mod doesn't change any existing thing in the game, it should be compatible with every mod.The Fleet Overseer ship can be bought from the Independents, but if they don't seem to sell it,

you can change its chance to show up in the data/world/factions/default_ship_roles.json file
